faq.q: Can I use this image as an Amazon main photo?
faq.a: The tool creates a plain white square product image. Whether it fits a particular main-image slot depends on the current category and listing requirements.
Use a sharp photo with the whole item, including straps, handles and labels, inside the frame; a simple background helps.
The example settings on this page use square format. Other crops depend on the photo tool you choose.

faq.q: Will my product photos be public?
faq.a: Your uploads are private to your account. Avoid including personal information or unrelated items in a product photo.

faq.q: What makes a white-background photo useful?
faq.a: Use even light, a complete product silhouette and a soft contact shadow on a clean white field.

faq.q: Can I show a single product at a time?
faq.a: Yes. A single centered item keeps edges, shape and details easy to inspect.

overview.d: A plain white product photo puts an item against an uncluttered field for a store listing. Upload a phone shot that includes straps, handles and labels, then choose a centered square crop. A soft shadow can help the item sit on the page without adding props or a tabletop scene.
